title: On automorphism group of the reduced finitary power monoid of the additive group of integers
summary: Let $\mathbb{Z}$ be the additive group of all integers and $\mathbb{N}$ the sub-monoid of $\mathbb{Z}$ of all non-negative integers. For a finite subset $X$ of $\mathbb{Z}$, we denote by ${\rm max}\ X$ the maximum member in $X$. %Recently, Tringali and Yan (\cite{tri2}, J. Combin. Theory Ser.
